page.layout: Running head across the top: "De Episcopatu" and the section mark "§. II." at the right. One column of running text, no margin notes. A stain at the bottom, not printed text.

main_text.p: tus esse, de eâ introducendâ ubi nondum exercetur, conservandâ ubi in usu est, vindicandâ ubi corrumpitur, restaurandâ ubi collapsa est, & quidem haec omnia secundum praescriptum verbi Dei. Haec propositio est etiam totius Ecclesiae Reformatae doctrina, quemadmodum recte pronunciat Sibbrandus contra Grotium p. 115. &c. & Cl Walæus lib. allegato p. 58. ait; omnes Reformatos Theologos fateri Magistratui competere inspectionem etiam & potestatem in rebus Religionis. Vide loca & Confess. modo laudatas, speciatim Belgic. art. 36. Helv. c. 30. Scot. art. 24.

Probatur haec propositio 1. ex Deut. 17. 18. 19. 20. 2. Reg. 18. 6. Rom. 13, 4. 1. Tim 2. 2. Deinde ex praxi piorum Regum ac PrincipuV.[?] T. qui summopere laudantur ob curam illam quemadmodum è contrario vituperantur ii principes qui curam illam verè religionis non habuerunt. Ubi observandum omnes pios Principes curam gessisse verae Religionis ex mandato

page.notes: Top line begins with a fragment "tus", kept as printed. "PrincipuV.[?]" is doubtful: the printed letters look like a line-end error or abbreviation. "§. II." in the running head is a doubtful reading of the section mark. The last paragraph runs on to the next page; no catchword is visible. The dark blot at the bottom is a stain and was not transcribed.
